content.title: Is Trader Joe's Open on Easter Sunday? What to Know for 2026
content.text: Is Trader Joe's Open on Easter? Details on 2026 Holiday HoursGoing to Trader Joe's this Easter? Here's what to know about the grocery chain for Sunday, April 5.April 4, 2026, 2:00 PM CDTGoing to Trader Joe's this Easter? Find out if stores will be open this Sunday, plus holiday hours.Kevin Carter / Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleEaster falls on Sunday, April 5, this year. For many people, it's a day to attend church service, gather with loved ones or take time out to enjoy a bit of springtime weather. One of the biggest commemorations on the Christian calendar, Easter is often marked by family get-togethers and, of course, a visit from the Easter Bunny. However you plan to spend the April holiday, you may be wondering if Trader Joe's is open on Easter in case you need to grab a few essentials for Easter brunch, groceries for the week ahead or anything else on your to-do list.If that's the case, see below for details on Trader Joe's Easter hours for 2026. For the most up-to-date information, TODAY.com reached out to the popular retailer to find out if stores will be open or closed this Sunday, as well as specifics on Trader Joe's holiday hours and other details. Find all the facts you need on Trader Joe's this Easter, as well as a roundup of store hours for other grocers to ensure that this year's Easter celebration is a hoppin' success.According to a Trader Joe's spokesperson, the grocery chain will be open on Sunday, April 5, and stores will be open during normal business hours.The exception is Trader Joe's in Portland, Maine, which will be closed on Easter in accordance to state law.Given that hours may vary by location, it’s a good idea to confirm local Trader Joe’s store hours ahead of going. Find stores, hours and other details using the Trader Joe's locator, which you'll find right here.Stores Open Easter Sunday 2026See below for a sampling of other grocery stores that will also be open on Easter or find a complete list right here. BJ’s Wholesale Club: A majority of BJ’s clubs will be open on Easter Sunday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Confirm local hours before going. Find local hours here.Harris Teeter: Stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Kroger: A majority of stores will operate during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Meijer: Stores will be open during normal business hours, which are typically 6 a.m. to midnight. Find local hours here.Stop and Shop: Stores will be open from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Pharmacies are closed. Find local hours here. Walmart: Stores will be open during normal business hours.
